topic: Write a Survival Story(写一篇求生故事)
genre: 记叙文 / 故事(write a short survival story set in a dangerous place)
source: 外研社版选择性必修第二册 Unit 6 Developing ideas / Writing:写一篇求生故事(危险的地点 + 危险 + 如何活下来 + 心情),自然用上 -ever 与 no matter 让步状语从句。
prompt_cn: 想象你被困在一个危险的地方(如南极、太空、丛林),必须设法活下来。用英语写一篇约 90 词的求生故事,内容包括:① 你在哪里、面对什么危险;② 你已经做了什么来活下来;③ 你接下来打算怎么做;④ 你的心情。要求至少用上一个 -ever 或 no matter 引导的让步状语从句。
prompt_en: Imagine you are trapped in a dangerous place (for example, Antarctica, space or the jungle) and must survive. Write a short survival story of about 90 words. Include: 1) where you are and what dangers you face; 2) what you have already done to stay alive; 3) what you plan to do next; 4) how you feel. Use at least one adverbial clause with -ever or no matter.
points: 交代地点与危险(I am trapped in … / The biggest danger is …)
已做的求生行动(So far, I have … to stay alive)
下一步打算(Next, I will … / My plan is to …)
心情 + 用上 -ever / no matter 从句(However hard it is, I will not give up. / No matter what happens, …)
model_essay: I am trapped alone on Mars after a dust storm cut me off from the others. The biggest dangers are the deadly radiation outside and my shrinking supply of food. So far, I have stayed inside the landing capsule and found an underground store of ice, which gives me water and oxygen. Next, I will try to grow plants in the Martian soil with the seeds I carry. However hard this is, I refuse to give up. No matter what happens, I will keep calm and hopeful until rescue comes.
model_translation: 一场沙尘暴让我与其他人失去联系,我被独自困在火星上。最大的危险是外面致命的辐射和不断减少的食物。到目前为止,我一直待在着陆舱里,还找到了一处地下冰库,它给我水和氧气。接下来,我打算用随身携带的种子在火星土壤里种植物。无论这有多难,我都不会放弃。无论发生什么,我都会保持冷静和希望,直到救援到来。

rubric.criteria: 四要素齐全:地点与危险 / 已做的求生行动 / 下一步打算 / 心情
按时间顺序展开、情节连贯、代词指代清楚、过渡自然
句型词汇准确多样、至少正确使用一个 -ever / no matter 让步状语从句、语法基本无误

required_structure: 地点与危险 I am trapped in … The biggest danger is …
已做行动 So far, I have …
心情 + 让步从句 However hard this is, I refuse to give up. / No matter what happens, …
key_expressions: I am trapped alone on Mars after a dust storm.
So far, I have found an underground store of ice.
However hard this is, I refuse to give up.
No matter what happens, I will keep calm and hopeful until rescue comes.

high_sentences: I am trapped alone on Mars after a dust storm cut me off from the others.
So far, I have stayed inside the landing capsule and found an underground store of ice.
However hard this is, I refuse to give up.
No matter what happens, I will keep calm and hopeful until rescue comes.

error_pairs.wrong: However it is hard, I will not give up.
error_pairs.correct: However hard it is, I will not give up.
error_pairs.note: however 后紧跟形容词/副词:however + adj. + 主语 + 谓语。

error_pairs.wrong: No matter what happen, I keep calm.
error_pairs.correct: No matter what happens, I keep calm.
error_pairs.note: what 作主语时谓语用第三人称单数 happens。

error_pairs.wrong: Whatever the danger is, but I keep trying.
error_pairs.correct: Whatever the danger is, I keep trying.
error_pairs.note: 让步状语从句后主句不再用 but;-ever 从句本身已含让步义。

paragraph_template:
【求生故事结构】
第1-2句 地点与危险:I am trapped in … The biggest danger is …
第3-4句 已做的行动:So far, I have …
第5句 下一步:Next, I will …
第6句 心情 + 让步从句:However hard this is, I refuse to give up. No matter what happens, I will keep calm and hopeful.
